name: What are the common signs of wind damage to siding?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of wind damage to siding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of wind damage to siding include loose or missing panels, cracks, dents from airborne debris, and impact marks. You might also notice a rattling sound during windy conditions, or water stains on interior walls if the wind damage has allowed moisture to penetrate. Inspect all sides of your home, especially after a major storm, to identify any areas where siding may be compromised.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs of wind damage include loose, missing, cracked, or dented siding panels, and impact marks from debris.
